feedback: Correct the Table 8 lookup logic. For steelMaterialClassOne at thickness bands (30,35] and (35,40] (and verify the corresponding 40–45 boundary), Polar Classes PC1–5 require steelGradeE for normalStrengthSteelCategory and steelGradeEh for highTensileSteelCategory, while PC6–7 require steelGradeD/DH; the current band<=8 branch incorrectly returns D/DH for class one regardless of Polar Class. Also mark steelMaterialClassThree with normalStrengthSteelCategory as NOT_APPLICABLE for both PC1–3 and PC4–5 in the (45,50] band; the current notApplicable condition covers only PC1–3, allowing an erroneous required grade for PC4–5. Preserve the existing owner paths, conditional required-grade cardinality, and family-scoped rank comparison.

Repair the Table 8 lookup while preserving the existing owner paths, conditional required-grade semantics, and family-scoped rank comparison. The current branches are not faithful: class 1 incorrectly returns D rather than B for (10,15]; class 2 incorrectly returns B/DH-family equivalents for PC6-7 in (25,30]; and class 3 incorrectly returns B/AH for PC6-7 in (10,35], and returns the wrong grades across the 35-40, 40-45, and 45-50 bands. Implement the exact table rows, including class-3 PC1-3 high-tensile FH in the 35-50 bands, the proper PC4-5 and PC6-7 values, and the normal-strength NOT_APPLICABLE combinations. Extend NOT_APPLICABLE for steelMaterialClassThree, normalStrengthSteelCategory, thickness (45,50] to both PC1-3 and PC4-5; the current condition covers only PC1-3 and therefore permits an erroneous required grade for PC4-5. Ensure all applicable branches require the exact result and all non-applicable branches reject any result.
